headline: Do Cardinal Health’s New Home-Health Deals Reshape the Bull Case for CAH?
summary: Earlier this week, Cardinal Health announced agreements to acquire AdaptHealth's Diabetes Health business and Strive Medical for about US$360 million in cash, aiming to expand its at-Home Solutions footprint in diabetes management and urology. These moves, combined with management’s previously raised profit guidance and a history of earnings outperformance, highlight Cardinal Health’s push to deepen its role in home-based care while emphasizing cost efficiency.
